main_result: Theorem 1.1 bounds |ψ(x)−x|/x for x≥x0≥e³ using D≈0.1982767 and the tabulated factor L(x0), with L(e³)=0.2390. Theorem 1.4 separately transfers a stipulated half-plane to a PNT bound.
read_scope: Targeted theorem and proof-interface check. Numerical interval estimates and Sage code not independently audited.
selection_reason: Unconditional explicit PNT input gives an effective constant for the prime-to-integral substitution in Gonek Lemma 8.
source_locator: PDF pp. 4–5 Theorems 1.1 and 1.4; pp. 44–45 Theorems 5.2–5.3 and §§5.1–5.2
title: Explicit bounds for the prime number theorem
transfer_hypothesis: Only Theorem 1.1 is used for the unconditional Abel substitution constant. Theorem 1.4 and its σ=7/8 example inherit their half-plane assumption. No improvement for the other Gonek constants or C₂ follows.

main_result: Theorem 1.3 evaluates the fixed-character continuously weighted one-level density for real 1/2≤σ≤1 and Schwartz tests with Fourier support in (−σ/(σ+1),σ/(σ+1)), without GRH in this support range. Theorem 1.4 treats distinct characters.
read_scope: Targeted theorem and proof-interface checks, including the unconditional test space, fixed conductor and central density contrast; no independent full AFE audit.
selection_reason: New Fourier support for a fixed-character continuous weighted one-level statistic, including q=1; a precise scope comparator for the Observatory derivative-root law.
source_locator: PDF §§1.1–1.4, §2 AFE setup, §§3–4 normalized twists and Theorems 4.1 and 4.3, Appendix A
title: Twisted second moments of Dirichlet L-functions with applications to weighted one-level density
transfer_hypothesis: Tempered Schwartz tests with compact Fourier support admit an entire extension to complex zero coordinates. At q=1 the fixed-twist estimate is weaker than the existing shifted aggregate J bound; the continuous height law does not estimate the long discrete additive prime twist.
